leaders.name: qS142_H1_1207
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Sort u0) (b : Prop) (s : Decidable b) (x y : α) (b_1 : Bool) (x_1 y_1 : α), Eq b (Eq b_1 Bool.true) → (Eq b_1 Bool.true → Eq x x_1) → (Not (Eq b_1 Bool.true) → Eq y y_1) → Eq (ite b x y) (bif b_1 then x_1 else y_1)

leaders.name: qS113_H1_1254
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Sort u0) (b : Bool) (y x : α), Eq (ite (Not (Eq b Bool.true)) y x) (bif b then x else y)

leaders.name: qS06_H1_234
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (a b c : Prop), Not (Or b c) → Iff (Or (Or a b) c) (Or a c)
leaders.gloss: If two possibilities are both impossible, they vanish from every case split. An excluded alternative costs nothing and changes nothing.

leaders.name: qS05_H1_907
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (a c a_1 b : Prop), Iff a (Or a_1 b) → Iff (Or a c) (Or (Or a_1 c) (Or b c))
leaders.gloss: If two statements describe the same situation, splitting cases by either one gives the same world, grouped differently.

leaders.name: qS06_H1_145
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Sort u0) (P : Prop) (inst : Decidable P) (x y : α) (b : Bool) (x_1 y_1 : α), Iff P (Eq b Bool.true) → Eq x x_1 → Eq y y_1 → Eq (ite P x y) (bif b then x_1 else y_1)
leaders.gloss: A decidable yes/no question is the same question whether asked in the language of propositions or of bits.

leaders.name: qS08_H1_290
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Type u0) (x : BEq α) (x_1 : Hashable α) (l : List α) (k : α) (f : Unit → Unit), EquivBEq α → LawfulHashable α → EquivBEq α → LawfulHashable α → List.Pairwise (fun (a b : α) => Eq (BEq.beq a b) Bool.false) l → Eq (Std.HashMap.size (Std.HashMap.modify (Std.HashMap.unitOfList l) k f)) (List.length l)
leaders.gloss: A filing system is sound exactly when two entries collide only if they were always the same entry.

leaders.name: qS42_H1_434
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (n : Int) (x : Real), Eq (Real.sin (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv Real.pi (2 : Real)) (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (Int.cast n) (HMul.hMul (2 : Real) Real.pi)) x))) (Real.cos x)
leaders.gloss: A sine wave shifted a quarter turn, wound any number of times, is the cosine. Phase is one object, not two.

leaders.name: qS66_H1_1198
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Type u0) (m0 : MeasurableSpace α) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (t s t_1 : Set α), MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet t μ → Filter.EventuallyEq (MeasureTheory.ae μ) (Inter.inter s t) t_1 → Eq (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict μ t) s) (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict μ t_1)

leaders.name: qS70_H1_324
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Type u0) (γ : Type u1) (x : BEq α) (x_1 : Hashable α) (f : α → Unit → γ) (l : List α), EquivBEq α → LawfulHashable α → EquivBEq α → LawfulHashable α → List.Pairwise (fun (a b : α) => Eq (BEq.beq a b) Bool.false) l → Eq (Std.HashMap.size (Std.HashMap.map f (Std.HashMap.unitOfList l))) (List.length l)
leaders.gloss: A filing system is sound exactly when two entries collide only if they were always the same entry.

leaders.name: qS17_H1_511
leaders.conclusion: ∀ (α : Type u0) (inst : PseudoMetricSpace α) (s : Set α) (c : Real) (β : Sort u1) (q : β → Prop) (e : Equiv (Subtype fun (a : Real) => And (LE.le c a) (∀ ⦃x : α⦄, Membership.mem s x → ∀ ⦃y : α⦄, Membership.mem s y → LE.le (Dist.dist x y) a)) (Subtype fun (b : β) => q b)), Iff (Bornology.IsBounded s) (Exists fun (b : β) => q b)
leaders.gloss: Everything beyond a threshold distance, collected with its certificate, is the same region no matter how the threshold is phrased.
